flags.why: The intensifier meaning is widely used outside Southern Vietnamese, so the Southern restriction is misleading.
This cooking sense means cooking in plenty of water until very soft, rather than steaming ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-bung)).
flags.fix: to cook in plenty of water until very soft

flags.why: This cooking usage is established in Northern cuisine and is incorrectly restricted to Central Vietnamese ([Northern usage](https://vnexpress.net/doi-song-cooking-bun-bung-ha-noi-nau-theo-loi-cu-4769622.html)).
The military meaning remains current and should not be marked dated.
